name: client-resource-access-action-negative-test-1519220005/client-resource-call-negative-e.bal
spec_references: Expressions: lists "New expression" and "Client resource access action", but does not list object constructor expressions.
Other invocation restrictions: "Client resource access actions require an atomic client receiver. Dispatch is not supported when more than one resource method matches the access path."
reason: The test requires anonymous object constructor expressions (`client object { ... }` and `object { ... }`) to establish receivers for its resource argument and ambiguity diagnostics. Object constructor expressions are not covered by the supported Expressions list; support for object/class members does not establish support for constructing anonymous objects. This essential construct makes the whole case a feature.
unsupported_constructs: Anonymous object constructor expressions, including client object constructors.
test_design_notes: Assertions are compile-time @error markers; no @args, @panic or @output behavior is present.
Illegal argument combinations and ambiguous accesses alone do not establish missing support: negative rejection within supported grammar/type rules is in scope.
